articles.title: Ahaana Krishna and Nimish Ravi announce their marriage
articles.dek: Malayalam actor Ahaana Krishna and cinematographer Nimish Ravi have shared their wedding news after getting married on September 13, 2026.
articles.author: KeralaCelebrities.com
body: Malayalam actor Ahaana Krishna and cinematographer Nimish Ravi have announced that they are married. The couple shared wedding photographs on social media on September 15, confirming that the ceremony took place on September 13, 2026.

Nimish Ravi is known for his cinematography work, including the Malayalam film Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra. The wedding announcement formally confirmed a relationship that had attracted public attention in the weeks before the announcement.

The development adds another notable personal milestone to Ahaana Krishna’s career in Malayalam cinema. KeralaCelebrities.com will continue to track verified career and film-industry updates involving the actor.

articles.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit crosses ₹300 crore worldwide
articles.dek: Girish A.D.’s Bethlehem Kudumba Unit, starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju, has crossed the ₹300 crore mark worldwide according to recent industry reports.
articles.author: KeralaCelebrities.com
body: Girish A.D.’s Malayalam film Bethlehem Kudumba Unit has crossed ₹300 crore in worldwide gross, according to recent reports. The film stars Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju and has emerged as a major box-office story for Malayalam cinema in September 2026.

The reported milestone follows a rapid theatrical run, with the film also being reported as having crossed ₹200 crore worldwide within its first 12 days. Box-office figures can vary between trade sources, so KeralaCelebrities.com treats reported collections as source-attributed figures rather than independently audited numbers.
The film’s performance has also generated reactions from other Malayalam filmmakers and actors, adding to the wider conversation around the current commercial reach of Malayalam cinema.

articles.title: Menaka Suresh returns to Malayalam cinema with Oru Korean Confusion
articles.dek: Veteran actor Menaka Suresh is returning to Malayalam cinema with Sanjeev Sivan’s upcoming film Oru Korean Confusion.
articles.author: KeralaCelebrities.com
body: Veteran actor Menaka Suresh is making a return to Malayalam cinema with Oru Korean Confusion, a film written and directed by Sanjeev Sivan. The project is currently being filmed in Idukki.
The film also features South Korean actor Ami Jung, who is making her Indian-cinema debut. The project brings together a Malayalam cast and an international performer around a cross-cultural story.

The return marks another upcoming project to watch in the Malayalam film calendar. Release details and further production information can be added to the KeralaCelebrities.com movie database as they are officially announced.
